summary: If the default container subnet clashes with your network ('No route to host'), on every controller and hybrid node create /etc/tower/conf.d/custom.py (mode 640, root:awx) with DEFAULT_CONTAINER_RUN_OPTIONS = ['--network', 'slirp4netns:enable_ipv6=true,cidr=192.168.1.0/24'] and restart automation-controller-service.
questions: How do I change the container subnet used by automation controller jobs?
Why do jobs get 'No route to host' in AAP containers?

answer_card.title: Change the job container subnet
answer_card.answer_md:
On every controller and hybrid node:
```bash
touch /etc/tower/conf.d/custom.py
chmod 640 /etc/tower/conf.d/custom.py
chown root:awx /etc/tower/conf.d/custom.py
```
Add to `custom.py`:
```python
DEFAULT_CONTAINER_RUN_OPTIONS = ['--network', 'slirp4netns:enable_ipv6=true,cidr=192.168.1.0/24']
```
Then `automation-controller-service stop` and `start`. Containers use the new CIDR.
